issue_request: FHIR-17783 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request for FHIR-core Observation raised in STU3. It reported that the oxygenSat profile looked confused with head circumference and resolved the issue by fixing the summary file as a cut-and-paste error.
initial_application: The Jira comment identifies commit 98752dd6c14e0ad544430fd0d7457f25282173d0. That historical commit changed the old oxygen saturation vitals profile spreadsheet summary from the head-circumference LOINC code 9843-4 and UCUM length units cm/[in_i] to the oxygen saturation LOINC code 2708-6 and UCUM percent unit.
additional_context: The old spreadsheet source no longer exists after later vital-sign profile refactors. The current source uses source/observation/structuredefinition-profile-oxygensat.xml, and source/observation/implementationguide-Observation-vitalsigns.xml references StructureDefinition/oxygensat while source/fhir.ini lists Observation as an active resource. Jira neighborhood search found only the seed and a broader older vital-sign alignment issue, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no directly relevant conflicting evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current oxygen saturation profile summary and differential already identify Oxygen Saturation, LOINC 2708-6, ValueSet/observation-vitalsign-oxygensat, OxygenSaturationUnits, ValueSet/ucum-oxygensat, and the percent unit; targeted stale-value searches found no head-circumference/body-length remnants in the oxygen saturation profile or value sets.
